programs.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Day or Night"
programs.desc: Dave handles a college AC unit and a historic ride, Brad and Nathan battle wind lifting trusses, and Dan and Francis work the night shift underground.

programs.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Ticket to Ride"
programs.desc: Brad and Nathan build a fire training unit, Dave works on amusement rides, and Dan and Francis lift a massive excavator from a construction pit.

programs.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Look Who’s Lifting Now"
programs.desc: Apprentice Eden tackles her first big lift. Dan and Francis work a hydro dam, Brad and Nathan assemble a gantry, and J.P. moves steel beams.

programs.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Long COVID"
programs.desc: Emma meets Dr. Asad Khan, whose life was upended by long COVID, as new research seeks answers for millions still suffering worldwide.

programs.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Rewilding Bison"
programs.desc: Emma Keeling treks through Romania’s Tarcu Mountains to see how European bison, once extinct in the wild, are making a comeback.

programs.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - ""The Way" to Fusion"
programs.desc: Neil Cairns visits ITER in France, where nuclear fusion could provide unlimited clean energy, to see progress and challenges firsthand.
